text: Losum is an Argonian Laborer working at Daram Stables in the Brass Fortress. He has no Unique Dialogue

Lorkh, also known as the Spirit of Man, the Mortal Spirit, or the Sower of Flesh, is the name by which the Reachmen know Lorkhan. Much like other variations of the Missing God, Lorkh is responsible for the making of the world, which he purposely made into a hard and painful place. The Reachmen believe that hardship is a means to wisdom, and that it was Lorkh who provided it. Therefore, the Reachmen praise and venerate Lorkh's wisdom.
Lotaeel is an Argonian residing in the Dwemer ruins of Nchuleftingth, Vvardenfell. He is part of Neramo's expedition team there.
Lost Paladin is a Nord ghost in that is a part of the Chrysamere Creation Club content.
Lugrun is an Orsimer located in Thizzrini Arena, Reaper's March, in .
Lorthus was a Dunmer thief incarcerated in Whiterun's Dungeon for murder.
Mabarrabael is a Dunmer Hunter and member of the Ahemmusa Tribe of Ashlanders. He lives in Mamaea's Yurt in the Ahemmusa Camp. He spends most of his time in the yurt or outside hunting.

King Lysandus, also known as the Dragon of Daggerfall, was a king of Daggerfall during the Third Era. He ascended to the throne after the death of his father Arslan II. Under his rule, he earned the trust of Emperor Uriel Septim VII as both a loyal vassal king and a personal ally, and his kingdom became one of the dominant powers in the Iliac Bay alongside Sentinel and Wayrest. Lysandus was killed under mysterious circumstances at the beginning of the Battle of Cryngaine Field, at the end of the War of Betony, and was succeeded by his son Gothryd. His widow was Mynisera, who was the Dowager Queen of Daggerfall. His son and successor is Gothryd, the current King of Daggerfall. Lysandus' mothe

M'aiq the Liar is a recurring source of misinformation in the Elder Scrolls series, featured in , , , and . He was introduced by the game designers as an easter egg to provide commentaries about the Elder Scrolls series.

Lyrisius was a hero who fought against an Akaviri invasion of an unknown date. What is known is that he fought a wyrm (likely a Dragon)—and, using trickery and deceit, tricked the dragon into destroying the Akaviri army. His prized artifact, Fearstruck, given to him by Boethiah, was destroyed by this wyrm, however.
Maela Kaushad is a Dunmer Wise Woman who resides in her farmhouse in Vos on the east coast of Vvardenfell.

M'raaj-Dar is a Khajiit merchant in the Cheydinhal Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary. He sells a variety of items, including some unique enchanted weapons and poisoned apples, and is also a spell merchant with unique Dark Brotherhood-themed spells. He is notable for his instant and great dislike of the Hero of Kvatch, which he eventually renounces at the end of his life.
Maelona is a Redguard who often sits in the middle of Anvil looking for someone to help her husband Gogan. She can also be found in her home with her husband.
Mach-Na is the Argonian owner of Mach-Na's Books in Cheydinhal. She is an Apprentice mercantile trainer. She has 1200 and offers a unique scroll called "Chronicle of Sacrifice."
Lyra Rosentia is an Imperial commoner and resident of Bruma, and is a patron of the Jerall View Inn. Lyra can be found within her house during the evening and night.

Ma'zaddha is a Khajiit thief who lives in Crucible, Dementia, in the Shivering Isles. He has a part in the conspiracy towards Syl and leaves Ma'zaddha's Crinkled Note for the Hero in the quest The Lady of Paranoia.
Lunia Menanius is an Imperial Warrior who resides in Ansi, Morrowind.
Lurius Lalelius is a hostile Imperial slaver warrior who resides in the slaver cave of Zainsipilu.
Luspinian Hertarian is an Imperial Sharpshooter who resides in Tel Vos, Morrowind. He is a retainer who works for House Telvanni.

Luven is an Imperial Thief who resides in Venim Ancestral Tomb, Morrowind. In Nerano Ancestral Tomb and Indaren Ancestral Tombs can be found accounts of Luven's betrayal of a group of the Smugglers of Morrowind, for the benefit of his master Goris the Maggot King.

Madesi is an Argonian jeweler found in Riften's town square. He remains one of the few traditional Saxhleel jewelers in Tamriel. Madesi lives in Beggar's Row, under the Riften canals. For most of the day, he waits around his stand for customers, before having a final meal at Haelga's Bunkhouse, and returning to the canals once more, to sleep with two other beggars.
Lynly Star-Sung is a Nord bard and barmaid residing in the town of Ivarstead. She works at the Vilemyr Inn.
Ma'jhad is a Khajiit warrior who travels the roads of Skyrim.
Madanach, also known as The King in Rags, is the leader of the Forsworn Rebellion. He is imprisoned in Cidhna Mine, deep beneath the city of Markarth.

Madena is a Breton mage and the court wizard of Jarl Skald of Dawnstar. She may be found inside The White Hall in Dawnstar. She can also be seen outside Silus Vesuius' house arguing with Silus when the Dragonborn is about to begin the quest "Pieces of the Past." She advises the Dragonborn against entering his house.
Ma'randru-jo is a Khajiit caravaner who is found traveling alongside Ri'saad, a traveling caravan trader who wanders the roads of Skyrim with his caravan.

Lymdrenn Telvanni was once a member of the Great House Telvanni during the Accession War in 4E 06, in the province of Morrowind. Lymdrenn was a casualty of the Accession War, when the Argonians under the command of the An-Xileel, invaded Morrowind and slaughtered House Telvanni.
Ma'tasarr is a deceased Khajiit bandit whose corpse can be found inside Bloated Man's Grotto. He was one of the Hunters of Hircine sent to kill Sinding, but was instead killed by his intended victim.

Ma'zaka is a Khajiit citizen who is the keeper of the Solitude Lighthouse. He is responsible for keeping the lighthouse beacon lit so that visiting ships may safely navigate along the northern coast of Skyrim.
Luminary Kaz is a Nord heretic mage apostle who resides inside the fort The Howling Halls. He is the personal aid for Ciirta in her quarters.

Lurio Maenius is an Imperial unused character. Lurio was removed from the game for unknown reasons and can only be interacted with if Console commands are used. If added to the game, he can be found in the Talos Plaza District of the Imperial City standing wherever he was spawned.

M'dasha is a Khajiit commoner who resides in his home in the settlement of Border Watch. Like his fellow townsfolk, M'dasha believes that once the Three Signs of K'sharra appear, it will be the end of the world.
M'dirr is a Khajiit commoner living in Border Watch and shares his house with Tsramla.
Ma'Raska is a Khajiit worshipper of the Daedric Prince Clavicus Vile. He can be found at the Shrine of Clavicus Vile alongside his fellow worshipers.

Lythelus was a priest of Nocturnal, whose place of worship was located at the Twilight Sepulcher. He was one amongst many other priests. He was assigned as a mentor to Nystrom, who deceived him into believing he wanted to become his pupil and worship Nocturnal. Lythelus inadvertently told him in riddles the trials one would have to face in order to get to the Inner Sanctum of the Twilight Sepulcher, where Nystrom and his companion Anders thought the treasure of the temple was located.
Mabrelle Geles is a Breton Acrobat residing in Maar Gan, in her house.

Macalla was the Queen of Dawnstar during the waning years of the Third Era, sometime around the Oblivion Crisis. Macalla was the leader of the Kingdom of Dawnstar during the Oblivion Crisis and was involved in a political marriage with King Thian of Solitude. The city-states of Dawnstar and Solitude were one of the more influential cities in Skyrim and had control all across the northern coast from Haafingar to Eastmarch. Thian and Macalla sought to expand their territory beyond the northern coast by taking Imperial fiefdoms in the Sea of Ghosts such as Roscrea and Bleakrock Isle. As of now, their progress is unknown. It was likely interfered by the abrupt Oblivion Crisis that ravaged Tamrie
Madran Ulvel is a Dunmer commoner found in Sadrith Mora. He can be found in his house opposite the Gateway Inn.
Maeli is a Dunmer who resides in Urshilaku Camp in the northern Ashlands. She can be found in her yurt.
Madsu Dreth is a Dunmer warrior, and resides in the cave of Ainat.
Lynoit is a Dawnguard field agent tasked with refilling Dawnguard caches throughout Skyrim.
M'Dara is a Khajiit Slave who resides on the Arvel Plantation.

Lurchers are creatures that appear in . Lurchers are a more masculine variant of Spriggan, and are often like so due to being cursed. Natural Lurchers can be found within swamps and forests and are sometimes used as guardians.
Lurog gro-Khagdum is an Orsimer warrior residing in the stronghold of Valenvaryon.
Lyrvekka is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact found in Davon's Watch. She can be seen wandering around the city, or talking with Murdyn Veralas. She cannot be interacted with.
Luzmash is an Orsimer found at the docks of the Deleyn's Mill. He is a resident of the Deleyn's Mill village in Glenumbra.
M'Shan is a Khajiit Slave who resides in the Arena of Rotheran.
Ma'Khar is a Khajiit Slave who resides in the Arena of Rotheran.
Ma'Zahn is a Khajiit Slave who resides in the slave cave of Zebabi.
Lurgonash gro-Dugronk is an Orsimer banker and proprietor of Dugronk's Impenetrable Fort in the marketplace in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai.

Mael Ancent is a Breton carpenter residing in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. He has his stall in the marketplace, Mael's Manufactory, in Port Hunding's Open Marketplace. He admits he is a terrible woodworker, but still sells materials for wood crafting.
Lusha is a Khajiit patron of the Five Claws Inn in Woodhearth.
Mad Zebba is a Khajiit member of the Undaunted. She is found at their enclave in Elden Root. She may also be found in the Aetherian Archive.
Machael is a Redguard residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. He is found at the Crosswych Inn, drinking.
Lysaux Niert is a Breton laborer who resides in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found admiring the buildings near Swineherd Wickton Swinery.

Ma'jhad Kha is a Khajiit member of the Ember-Eye Slavers. He leads the forces that took over Steelheart Moorings. He was once a slave himself, but killed his masters and competitors, taking over as a slaver king.
M'nashi was a Khajiit alchemist assisting Uncle Sweetshare refine moon sugar in Uncle Sweetshare's Workshop. His corpse can be found on the northern side of the workshop.
Mael is a Breton living at the Weynon Priory in Cyrodiil, east of Chorrol.
Lyse is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She is found sitting on the decks outside the city, looking out over the ocean.
Lyfskar Cold-Eye is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact found in Davon's Watch.
Luz is an Orsimer guild trader who can be found at the Plaza Trademarket in the city of Ebonheart.
Ma'jidid is a Khajiit guild trader. He operates his kiosk, The Anchor Exchange, in Kragenmoor.
Mach-Neeus is an Argonian residing in the Instruction Halls in Shad Astula.
Madame Lemaitre is a Breton civil servant who can be found at her house in the city of Wayrest. The Vestige cannot speak to her.
Maaga is an Orsimer historian residing in Anchor's Point Inn in the city of Evermore.
Mad Thadrig is a Nord patron of the Frozen Palms Tavern in Sentinel.

Lyranth, sometimes called Lyranth the Foolkiller, is a Dremora and the last remaining surviving member of the Foolkillers Clan. She is first found in Ten-Maur-Wolk in Shadowfen, where her essence is in the process of being extracted at the hands of the Aldmeri Dominion. Regardless of her fate in Ten-Maur-Wolk, she is later found at the Tower of Lies in Coldharbour, where she is assisting the Fighters Guild members being held captive there. She also helps the allied forces gain access to the inside of The Reaver Citadel and in the process, avenging her clan by slaying Valkynaz Seris. She is finally found in the Imperial City Prison, where she is tracking down Lord Warden Dusk.
M'harra is a Khajiit residing inside Raolin Munier's house in Wind Keep.
Lurnagne Malarelie is a character residing in the town of Wind Keep.
Lungird Scar-Hand is a Nord residing in the city of Windhelm.
Luxultava is an Argonian found inside the outlaws refuge beneath Windhelm.
Lupandinus Asina is an Imperial found at The Adept's Retreat in Windhelm.
Lyn the Bereft is a Nord part of the group of outlaws found inside the refuge in Windhelm.
Mabbritte Snow-Mane is a Nord in residing in the city of Windhelm, Eastmarch.
Macamir is a Altmer residing in the outlaws refuge beneath Elden Root.
Maebomaz is a creature that appears in . It is a boss Clannfear, and is located in Emberflint Mine. Defeating this creature will earn the achievement "Emberflint Mine."
Luruzesh is an Orsimer of the Barkbite Clan found at Reman's Bluff.
Madov Hlaalu is a Dunmer commoner and apparent family member of House Hlaalu, residing in Mournhold. He has no unique dialogue.
Mael Rotvine is a Reachman of the Boneshaper Clan. He is found inside Shor's Stone Mine.
Maedarri is a Khajiit found at the Skystep Stalls in Skywatch.
Madria Dralen is a Dunmer residing in Cropsford. She is found inside her father Almerel's warehouse. She is in love with an Imperial named Remius Balbus despite her father's disapproval.
Maalamenwe is an Altmer brewer selling her wares at Sundry Swills in Alten Corimont, Shadowfen.
Madgrubaga is an Orsimer residing in the city of Orsinium, Wrothgar.
Lumgol is an Orsimer member of the Fighters Guild residing in Martyr's Crossing, Bangkorai.
Lusts-For-Peace is an Argonian residing in Darkwater Crossing in Eastmarch.
Lunkruk is an Orsimer found working at the Daggerfall Docks. He has no unique dialogue.
Lyze Jeanne is a Breton beggar found in Anvil, The Gold Coast. She can be seen strolling across the docks, nearby the Prowler. She cannot be interacted with.
Lynda Carter is an Unused NPC found outside Todd's Testing House in Toddland. When passed by, a subtitle will read "This is Lynda Carter...", though no dialogue is spoken. She has no unique dialogue.
M'jaddha is a Khajiit residing in Wayrest. He is the brother of S'rashi, a debt collector working for the Midnight Union.
Luz gro-Graaum is an Orsimer member of the Horsemen found in Silverhoof Vale in Rivenspire.
Lunk is an Orsimer sailor residing in The Lost Fleet in Coldharbour.
Maahi is an Argonian found in the ruins of Loriasel. He is one of the few who survived when the Dominion stormed the place.
Madruin is an hostile Bosmer spirit serving as the boss of Vinedeath Cave. For unknown reasons, he has managed to lure many to the entrance of the cave, only to have them trapped in vines.
Lureau Delatte is a Breton stablemaster and member of the Daggerfall Covenant. He sells horses at the Northern High Rock Gate.
Lydi Snowpelt is a Reachman and the leader of the Rageclaw Clan in . She is found at the Three Tribes Camp.
Lyze Esmery is a Breton and a former resident of Moira's Hope. She is one of the few who survived the first bloodfiend attack.
M'nashaar is a Khajiit laborer in who is found working on the docks of Vulkhel Guard.
Mabit is a Khajiit guild trader. He operates his kiosk, Mabit's Bits and Bundles, at the trade hub in Orsinium.
Madame Bellyscratch is a Khajiit noble residing in Pa'alat, Reaper's March.
Maelen is a Khajiit mercenary merchant and a member of the Aldmeri Dominion. He sells his wares at the Eastern Elsweyr Gate.
Lurash gro-Fakal is an Orsimer drunkard residing in Wayrest, and is located inside the Cloudy Dregs Inn.
Lywen Nighthollow is a Bosmer thief and a member of Thieves Guild. In , she gives a player the Thieves Guild quests.

Luuniel was one of the four most talented chefs in Umbriel. He was invited to take part in Lord Rhel's tasting. Toel, Phmer and Ashdre were his opponents. Toel died, and Annaïg took the lead of his kitchen, beating the other chefs in the tasting.
Mabgrubaga is an Orsimer merchant located in Orsinium, near the Tailor & Dyes shop.
Lurg is an Orsimer commoner residing beneath Exile's Barrow. He was once the chief of his clan. He has two daughters; Mazgroth and Orluguk.
Athyn Rotheran is an Ashlander freed from Dreudurai Glass Mine during "An Armiger's Duty."

Maelanrith is a Bosmer guild trader that resides in Rimmen. She can be found at Rimmen Commerce Exchange at her stand, Tenmar Treasures. She was originally from Grahtwood, but left to become a guild trader.
Mach-Loh is a Argonian backpack merchant residing in Rimmen in Northern Elsweyr. He can be found at the Baandari Bazaar at the stall, Baan Dar's Backpacks, selling backpack upgrades.

M'jaddah is a Khajiit treasure hunter and the cousin of Saashi. He aids the Fugitive on several occasions. He was killed by the River Snake for investigating on behalf of the Fugitive. Wanum found him decapitated, and with the symbol of the Bloodfall Queen carved into his chest.

Luven Sulla is an Imperial noble residing in The Sugar Bowl in the city of Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. He can be found on the upper floor, where he is laughing with Tsradarri. He has no unique dialogue.

Lyna Ergene is a Breton that has taken shelter, like most of the other residents, within the Elinhir sewers away from the renegade Blackcaster Mages Guild. She guards the entrance with Mathondar Blackrock.

Lydette Viliane was a member of The Synod, whose research on Spriggans and Ice Wraiths led her to hypothesize that Wispmothers are not undead, as once believed, but rather elemental manifestations of snow or mist, and that they utilize the power of their element rather than manipulate conventional sorcery.
Madearn is a Reachman son of Chief Six-Ford, leader of Six-Ford Clan in .
M'egki is a Redguard servant in who resides in the court of Castle Sentinel.
Mad Griskild is a hostile Nord located in Bal Fell on Vvardenfell.
Luna Beriel is a Breton daily job broker located in Fargrave City District, Fargrave, in . She offers daily job quests for the Gleaners of Aurbis in the northwest part of Fargrave City District.
Madleena Blackvein is a character located in Reinhold's Retreat, Craglorn, in .
Lyris Doppelganger is a Nord located in the Halls of Torment during the quest "Halls of Torment" in .

Magnus Septim was the eleventh ruler of the Empire of Tamriel. He was the youngest son of Emperor Pelagius Septim II and Empress Quintilla. That made him half-brother of Antiochus Septim, brother to infamous Potema Septim and Cephorus Septim.

Maeva the Buxom is a Nord who resides on Whitmond Farm just north of Anvil. She is irritated that her husband has left her to join the local Marauder band at Fort Strand; he even stole her family heirloom, an enchanted Dwemer mace named Rockshatter.

Maglir is a Bosmer knight and a former member of the Fighters Guild. He later changes his allegiance to the Blackwood Company. He can initially be found in the taproom at the West Weald Inn in Skingrad.
Maenlorn is the Bosmer proprietor of The Flowing Bowl in Anvil. He has a twin brother, Caenlorn, who sometimes wanders about in the city, or in his brother's tavern.

Mahei is an Argonian who lives on the south side of Leyawiin with his "nagging fishwife" Numeen. Mahei is an Apprentice trainer of Athletics, and teaches in his house from 7:00 a.m. to past 9:00 p.m. When he is not in his house, he can be found wandering about the streets and various stores in Leyawiin throughout the day.

Magub gro-Orum is an Orsimer who resides in his home in Cheydinhal. He is one of the members of the Skooma dealers of the city. Magub wears a Burgundy Linen Shirt, Tan Linens, and Pigskin Shoes. He also carries a key to his home and some .
Maesa Gabinia is an Imperial bard who resides in The Lizard's Head in the Telvanni Canton.
Mahk is an Orsimer miner found in Dushnikh Mine, within the stronghold of Dushnikh Yal.

A Mage Scholar is a member of the Mages Guild found in the Arcane University of the Imperial City. They serve no integral purpose to the storyline, and their foremost job is lecturing the apprentices.

Maknok gro-Coblug is an Orsimer living in Cheydinhal with his wife, Rogmesh. Both he and his wife work at Riverview. While his wife works inside cooking and cleaning, Maknok works as the groundskeeper.
Maeonius Yentimilal is a Dunmer Scout who resides in the wilderness of the West Gash region of Vvardenfell.
Maesat Shinirbael is a Dunmer Barbarian and Ashlanders outcast found in his yurt in the Mamshar-Disamus Camp. Missun Hainterari can be found right outside Maesat's yurt.
Mal Mibishanit is a Dunmer barbarian residing at the Sobitbael Camp in the Azura's Coast region of Vvardenfell.
Mailic is a Redguard mercenary hired by Lord Vanech to guard and safely escort Decumus Scotti to the site of the Black Marsh building contract during the Third Era.
Magali Sterone is a Breton mage and member of the Mages Guild found in their camp in the Glenumbra Moors, High Rock.
Mage Vendras is a Dunmer mystic and a member of the Mages Guild residing in Mournhold. He can be found at the local branch, selling his wares.

Magistrix Urili Vox is the Dunmer leader of the Maulborn Cult, a group responsible for the creation and spreading of the Llodos Plague which is making its way across Deshaan. She is the region's primary antagonist.
Magnifico Jalid is a Redguard member of the Undaunted who resides in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He can be found drinking at the Rosy Lion inn or in Sisters of the Sands Inn in Sentinel.
Magula is an Orsimer residing on the island of Betnikh. She is found southeast of town at a shrine.
Maezalaya is a Khajiit residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade.
Mahiralit is a Khajiit found at the Altmer embassy in Elden Root.
Mahiba is a Redguard residing in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. She is walking in the outskirts of town with her horse.
Magdelena's Haunt is a camp and world boss location in the region of Rivenspire. The Hagraven named Magdelena resides here.
Magdelena is a Hagraven group boss residing in her camp of Magdelena's Haunt in Rivenspire.
Maiko K'Elmar is a character in . He runs the Cartographer's Shop and has the Smuggler's Den in his basement.
Magistrate Andrin at-Lehiel is a Redguard found at the Kozanset City Hall in the city of Kozanset.
Magnifico Khorshad is a Redguard residing in Satakalaam, in the Alik'r Desert region.
Mahrokh af-Jahannif is a character in , found in the Alik'r Desert city of Bergama.
Mahei-Jee is an Argonian commoner residing in Jin-Ei's House in the Sulfur Pools. She has no unique dialogue.
Magister Wulfdis is a Nord member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their guildhall in Shornhelm.
Maggie Jerine is a character residing in the town of Hoarfrost Downs.
Makes-No-Soup is an Argonian grocer found at Oaken-Hull's Emporium in the city of Windhelm.
Makmargo is a Khajiit guild trader. He operates his kiosk, Makmargo's Merchandise, in Port Hunding.
Major Carina is an Imperial officer of the Seventh Legion. She is part of the troops encountered within Razak's Wheel. She is the author of Carina's Journal.
Magna Tharn is an Imperial of House Tharn. She is a member of the Worm Cult cell within Rulanyil's Fall.
Magister Enuse is a Chimer. She was one of the mages who initially bound Balreth to Ash Mountain. She will appears during the quest "Rending Flames."
Maeroth is a Bosmer found inside the Ayleid ruins near Cormount. He is a member of the Vinedusk Rangers and serves as a guard to the hidden prison holding Gelthior.
Makhoguz is an Orsimer fence who runs "Framed & Fencing" out of the Outlaws Refuge in Velyn Harbor, Malabal Tor.
Majolrun is a Nord enchanter. He sells his wares at his stall, Magic and Mystery, at the trading hall in Bleakrock Village.
Maesar is a Khajiit carpenter. He sells his wares at his stall, Planed Plank Carpentry, in Rawl'kha.
Magunh is an Orsimer residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh.
Mahuza is a Redguard residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Maereeda is a Redguard merchant part of the gang found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Anvil.
Mahata is a Redguard found in Anvil. She is located around her brother's blacksmiths at the Anvil Ironworks and Tannery in Anvil, Gold Coast.
Majdazh is a Redguard residing in the Dockyards the city of Davon's Watch.
Mage Fiirenir is a deceased Altmer whose body can be found in his house in the city of Greenwater Cove, Auridon. He is the author of The Ancient Eye.
Makar the Elder is a Redguard member of the Horsemen found in Silverhoof Vale.
Makhayh is Redguard member of the Horsemen found in Silverhoof Vale, Rivenspire.
Malacath Priest is an Orsimer found beside the road at one of his possible locations in Wrothgar. He can grant Malacath's Blessing effect.
Major Cirenwe is an Altmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion found at the Seaside Sanctuary in Greenshade.
Mahlia is an aspect of the Celestial Mage appearing as an Altmer. She can be found within the Dwemer ruins of Rkundzelft during the quest The Shattered and the Lost.

Maheelius is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact in who is found along with Navlos and Smiles-With-Knife at their camp in Greenshade, where they act as a trio of bosses. They are also responsible for the capture of a Bosmer scouting party from Longhaven.
Makes-Many-Soups is an Argonian chef member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is stationed at Jorunn's Stand, where she cooks for the others. She can also be encountered at the celebration in Windhelm.
Makes-One-Soup is an Argonian chef. She works at Deldwine's Inn in Fort Amol.
Maenrin is a Bosmer found with his companion Hareglor at their campsite in Grahtwood. He can also be found at another camp in Eastmarch alongside Alander Stickyfoot.
Maesa is a Nord blacksmith. She works and sells her wares at her stall, The Hot Iron, at the trading hall in Bleakrock Village.
Magistrate Bogtro is a Dremora found in the Court of Contempt, Coldharbour, in .
Makhel Abbas is an unused Orsimer who was supposed to make an appearance in the unimplemented Civil War quest "CWMission11," but was not added to the final version of the game.
Mahazi is a Khajiit moon priestess. She is one of the few who survived the Stonefire Cult attack on the Do'Krin Monastery.
Maila is a Khajiit found at the Hackdirt refugee camp in Cyrodiil.
Majdi is a Khajiit found at their settlement in the Village of the Lost.
Mistress Therana is a Dunmer magister of House Telvanni. She can be found on Tel Branora on Vvardenfell. She is assisted by Sun-in-Shadow.
Magister Osanne is a Nord member of the Stormfist Clan. She is found inside Lost Knife Cave.
Majorn the Ancient is a Nord, the patriarch of Wittestadr and the father of Valeric. Depending on the choices made during the related quest, he may be fought inside the crypts beneath Wittestadr.

Magister Gothren is a Dunmer magister of House Telvanni, who will be found at Tel Aruhn on Vvardenfell. His Mouth is Ralasa Delvi. He serves as the primary antagonist of the House Telvanni questline in the chapter.
Maigarda is a Nord part of the group of outlaws found inside the refuge in Stormhold.
Malacath Strikers are generic members of the Malacath Fanatics who have stormed the Temple of Ire and have taken the priests hostage.
Malacath Sorcerer is a generic Orsimer residing in Ashurnibibi in Vvardenfell. They are hostile to the Vestige and will attack upon sight.
Magistrate Govan is a Redguard captive residing in Satakalaam.
Magna was the wife of Antiochus Septim, and the mother of Kintyra Septim II.
Magnate Feina-Darak is the Imperial leader of Hakoshae in Northern Elsweyr.
Mahazza is a Khajiit residing in Rimmen. He can be found bathing in the public square.
Maestro Efnort is a Nord residing in the Bards College in Solitude.
Maestro Viatrix Umbranox is an Imperial residing in the Bards College in Solitude.
Magister Fridelja is a Nord and court mage of Jarl Olfwenn of Karthwatch. After main quest The Gray Host she is residing in the Blue Palace in Solitude.
Magistrate Sulma is a Redguard magistrate of the Forebears in residing in Bergama, Alik'r Desert.
Mahvia is a deceased Nede located in Shada's Tear, Craglorn, in who died during the Yokudan invasion.

Magiul Shiana was a Breton who served as the royal chef and later Seneschal to King Anton of Daggerfall. His life and service are chronicled in his personal journal, which can be found in the Tomb of Lost Kings. After his death, his spirit became bound to the crown of King Anton, and he is encountered as the Forgotten Seneschal in .
Mankar Camoran is an Altmer and the leader of the Order of the Mythic Dawn.

Mara is a goddess of the Nine Divines. She is also known as Mother-Goddess and Goddess of Love in the Empire, and in Skyrim as handmaid of Kyne. She makes an appearance in almost every culture's pantheon in Tamriel, and at times is affiliated with Nir who gave birth to creation. While it differs from one religion to another, Mara may be married to, or act as a concubine of, either Akatosh or Lorkhan and in the Bosmeri Pantheon, as wife of Auri-El.
Malooc is an enemy god of the Ra Gada who led the goblins against the Redguards during the First Era. He fled east when the army of HoonDing overtook his goblin hordes.
Marayn Dren is a Dunmer mage in the Balmora Mages Guild. He offers training to guild members in Destruction, Mysticism, and Alteration.
Manis Virmaulese is a Breton Mage, and an Apprentice mage. He is left behind at the Ald'ruhn Mages Guild to defend it once the other Mages leave, for an undisclosed reason.

Manirai is a Dunmer Wise Woman living in Erabenimsun Camp, in Morrowind. She is the Wise Woman of her Ashlander clan and can be found in her yurt. She plays an important role during the main quest of , helping the Nerevarine with her counsel, and is thus tagged as an essential character.
Mansilamat Vabdas was a Dunmer miner working in the Gnisis Eggmine in Gnisis. His body is at the bottom of a pool and his ghost haunts the Underground Stream section of the mine.
Mandur Omalen is a Dunmer Trader in Molag Mar, Morrowind. He has a wide variety of wares for sale at the Redoran Stronghold where he resides without being a member of the House.
Mandyn Ralas is a Dunmer farmer who resides in his farmhouse in Vos.

Mandran Indrano is a Dunmer living in Ghostgate. He can be found at the Tower of Dusk. Mandran is a member of House Redoran. Mandran also serves as a trainer for the skills Athletics, Block, and Long Blade.

Marc Gulitte is a Breton mage associated with the Anvil Mages Guild. He will offer training in Destruction up to the Journeyman level and recharge enchanted weapons. He is always capped out at Level 17.
Mandil is a Bosmer Journeyman Security trainer who resides in the Elven Gardens District with Othrelos.
Malintus Ancrus is an Apprentice Security Trainer who lives in Chorrol.
Marana Rian is an Imperial who has a house in the Temple District in the Imperial City and sometimes eats at The All-Saints Inn in the same area. She walks around the Arboretum in the evenings.
Malpenix Blonia is an Imperial trader who resides in the city of Ald'ruhn. He runs his own shop inside the Redoran council hall and buys or sells all manner of items. These include weapons and armor.

Maramal is a Redguard priest who can be found in the Bee and Barb or in the Temple of Mara in Riften. He can sell an Amulet of Mara to the Dragonborn, allowing them to marry. He will be at the Bee and Barb the first time Riften is visited.
Malyn Varen is a Dunmer mage located within Azura's Star. He is the primary antagonist of the quest "The Black Star."
Mallus Maccius is an Imperial who works at the Honningbrew Meadery in . He is initially found in Whiterun at The Bannered Mare.

Mani is a deceased Redguard citizen. His corpse lies impaled on a ledge in the Frostflow Abyss, in Winterhold Hold. Mani's family recently took over the Frostflow Lighthouse, after moving to Skyrim from Hammerfell.
Malur Seloth is a Dunmer serving as steward to the Jarl of Winterhold. He spends all of his time either in the Jarl's Longhouse, or sitting on a bench outside The Frozen Hearth, skiving.
Maluril, fully Maluril Ferano, is a Dunmer mage and Dwemer researcher who can be found in Mzinchaleft.
King Mantiarco was King of Solitude in early Third Era. He was also husband of the infamous Wolf Queen Potema Septim.
Mallam Ryon is a Dunmer who is the Mouth of Arch-Mage Gothren. He is also a member of House Telvanni.

Manwe was a Atmoran warrior and craftsman. He was one of the Five Hundred Companions. He was an accomplished craftsman on Atmora, prior to the Day of Final Passage. He worked in the massive shipyards of Jylkurfyk. He and Menro were the ones that constructed one of the Five Hundred longboats, Jorrvaskr. During the Day of Final Passage Manwe was part of Jorrvaskr's crew and was under command of its captain, Jeek of the River. It is said that Menro and Manwe took Atmoran timbers with them. After arriving at Mereth and retaking Saarthal, Manwe as well as the rest of the crew went south to the area that was later known as Whiterun. Marcel Amelion is a Breton who after losing 1000 gambling and failing to pay it off, he is taken captive by his debtors. He is the son of Brusef Amelion and father of Biene Amelion.
Manicky is a Redguard and a member of House Telvanni found in Sadrith Mora.
Manse Andus is a Dunmer Publican residing in Maar Gan. She is located at her tavern Andus Tradehouse, where she buys and sells items.

Sometimes, they are successful in bringing temporary peace to the province; however, this does not last very long. Historically, the Mane has been known to reside in the city-state of Torval, where he is protected by his Warrior Guard.
Malay Ranarbatus is a Dunmer archer, and resides in a camp east of Khuul with several of his fellow bandits.
Mals Faralen is a Dunmer bandit barbarian, and resides in the cave of Zaintirari.
Malsa Ules is a Dunmer crusader who resides in Venim Manor in Ald'ruhn.
Mamaea Ashun-Idantus is a Dunmer Mabrigash residing in Shashurari Camp, Molag Amur.
Mamaea Ularshanentus is a Dunmer who resides in the Ashlands of Morrowind.
Mamusa Shashmassamsi is a Dunmer Mabrigash who resides on Azura's Coast.
Man-Ilu Ashananapal is a Dunmer Wise Woman who shares a camp with Anasour Selitbael and Mausur Assaplit near [5,13] in the Ashlands of Morrowind.
Manabi Kummimmidan is a Dunmer Wise Woman who resides at the Massahanud Camp in the Grazelands of Morrowind.
Manat Shimmabadas is a Dunmer barbarian and a former Ashlander residing in Mila-Nipal. He, along with two other Ashlander outcasts, have kidnapped Beden Giladren.
Manat Varnan-Adda is a Dunmer farmer who resides in the Ascadian Isles region.
Manel Amori is a Dunmer who resides in Morrowind. He is a Rogue and smuggler hiding in the cave Tin-Ahhe, in the northeastern part of the Ashlands.
Maner Uvaren is a Dunmer Battlemage who resides in Morrowind. He can be found at Kushtashpi, a shrine to Molag Bal.

Manirai Mirshamammu is a Dunmer Mabrigash who resides in the Grazelands of Morrowind. She can be found at a campfire, along with Shishi Yanumibaal and a chest containing some gold. She is hostile to the Nerevarine and will attack on sight.
Manu Odirnapal is a Dunmer Wise Woman residing in the Ashlands region.
Manu Zainab is a Dunmer Mabrigash who resides in Morrowind. She can be found at Ashamanu Camp on the first island due west of Tel Aruhn.
Maralie Ares is a Dunmer bard who resides in the stronghold of Rotheran. She is typically found in the stronghold's arena.
Malielle Broles is a Breton spellsword, and a member of House Telvanni residing in Sulipund.
Maranique Jolvanne is a Breton sorcerer in who can be found in the cave Abanabi.
Marcel Maurard is a Breton found in the Foreign Quarter Lower Waistworks. He is an actor who plays a role in the quest "The Bad Actor."

Malkoran's Shade is a creature in Kilkreath Ruins. It becomes the ultimate boss of "The Break of Dawn." The shade spawns once Malkoran's corporeal form is killed, and immediately attacks the Dragonborn upon spawning.
Manashir-do is a Khajiit warrior who may be found in the region of Reaper's March in the province of Valenwood.

Maraya is a Redguard noble, and the High Queen of Wayrest. She is the daughter of King Fahara'jad, and the wife of High King Emeric, whose marriage in the spring of 2E 566 brought a trade agreement between Wayrest and Sentinel that was greatly prosperous.

Mansel Sesnit, also known as the Elden Yokeda, was a Redguard Yokeda. He is one of the most notorious Yokedas due to the fact that he almost conquered the Yokudan Empire in the year 2245 of the Yokudan Calendar (1E 609) after eight years of conquest. He was assassinated in the Yokudan year 2253 (1E 617), whereupon the empire fell in control under Randic Torn.

Malareth is a Bosmer debt collector that was once found in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard. She and her quest were removed from the game in Patch 1.0.1, and it is unknown when or if she well be added again.

Malangwen is an Altmer mystic residing in Stonetooth Fortress, on the island of Betnikh. She can be found at her stall, Malangwen's Soul Swap, at the market near the docks, where she sells various magical items.

Marayna Murric is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. After the events with the Red Rook Bandits, she will be at the Mayor's House, cleaning upstairs. Before the events in Crosswych are resolved, Marayna can be seen outside, somewhere in town.
